verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents REST APIs and support for third-party payment protocols (x402, MPP) but there's no evidence of Crossmint itself publishing a versioned commerce protocol with a formal schema or conformance/validation tooling — the openapi.json/swagger.json probes all returned 404, and the 'live API reference' (crossmint-docs-19) is interactive docs, not a schema or conformance suite. missing for 10: published protocol schema (e.g. OpenAPI spec), version history/changelog for the protocol, and any conformance or validation tooling for third-party implementers.
